title: Compare and validate compact cross-encoder candidates for multilingual rerank
creator: Ethan Zhao
description: Goal: select a compact cross-encoder variant (or small family) to replace / augment the current reranking tier for multilingual workloads. We need models that meaningfully improve top-k quality (MRR@10 / NDCG@10) across EN/FR/DE/ES/JA while keeping P95 latency and memory footprint within Dedicated and Hosted constraints. This ticket covers evaluation, lightweight fine-tuning experiments, regression checks against established testsets, and rollout plan (canary -> phased).
acceptance_criteria: Candidate models evaluated on official rerank testsets (EN/FR/DE/ES/JA). Report includes MRR@10, NDCG@10, Recall@1 and per-language deltas vs baseline.
At least one compact candidate meets: >= +4% relative MRR@10 on average across languages OR >= +6% on any high-priority language with <5% regression elsewhere.
P95 latency on Hosted small instance for inference (single-query cross-encoder) <= 120ms when using optimized runtime and batching disabled (baseline measured under identical conditions).
Memory footprint (GPU VRAM) for 8-16 batch runs fits into Dedicated small pool VM (<= 16GB after quantization/optimizations).

Automated regression suite (unit + eval harness) added to CI and run on PRs to prevent model-quality regressions; failing threshold triggers blocking alert in Slack and an entry in the regression dashboard.
Canary rollout plan documented with metrics to monitor (quality, latency, error-rate, cost) and automated rollback criteria.
tasks: Assemble candidate list: distilled cross-encoders (distil-mMiniCross, compact-cx-large), 6-8 variants including 8-bit quantized and int4 sketches
Extend eval harness to support multilingual testsets with stratified query lengths and domain tags (supporting FR/DE/ES/JA).
Run baseline benchmark (current reranker) to capture MRR/NDCG and latency P50/P95/P99 under defined load profiles.
Run offline fine-tuning experiments on priority languages with augmentation (translation + hard negatives) and log artifacts to Drive.
Add telemetry hooks in API to record rerank decisions and per-request timing (tokenize -> encode -> score).
Create A/B config for canary traffic (5% then 20%) and implement automated monitoring jobs for quality degradation and latency spikes.
Document rollout steps and create runbook with rollback triggers and owner assignments.
notes: 2026-03-03 - initial list of candidates compiled. Focus on mMini/mini-cross distilled checkpoints to reduce compute cost.
2026-03-05 - perf baseline captured on hosted-small: baseline MRR@10=0.412, NDCG@10=0.475, P95 latency=98ms (single-query, no batching).
2026-03-07 - first distillation run (distil-mMiniCross-v1) showed +5% MRR on EN but -2.1% on FR; dataset imbalance suspected — added FR augmentation job.

2026-03-09 - eng design review: trade-off discussion: accept small regressions (<3%) on low-traffic languages for consistent latency improvement; PM pushed back on regressions for top-enterprise customers (FR/DE).
2026-03-11 - concluded that int8 quantization reduces P95 by ~15% with negligible impact on MRR for most candidates; int4 shows variable regressions on JA -- hold for now.
2026-03-12 - decision: shortlist two candidates (distil-mMiniCross-v1-int8, compact-cx-large-int8). Proceed to extended regression suite and canary config. Assigned canary ownership to Maya Lopez.
2026-03-13 - added regression tests to CI; initial PR created to wire telemetry (GH PR #678). Requested review from Lina Becker (PM) and Ben Carter (SRE).
risks: Cross-encoder latency may not meet Hosted SLOs under high-concurrency traffic; fallback to bi-encoder + cross-encoder for top-K may be required.
Quantization may introduce language-specific regressions (observed on JA); additional fine-tuning or per-language calibration may be needed.
Data leakage in augmented fine-tuning sets could inflate offline metrics; strict dedupe and date-splits required.
next_steps: Complete extended regression runs across all languages (target finish 2026-03-18).
Merge telemetry PR after addressing SRE comments and run canary in staging with 5% synthetic traffic.
If canary passes quality & latency gates for 72h, increase to 20% and run business-metric checks (CTR, downstream NLU accuracy) for another 72h.
If any language shows regression >3% on production testset, trigger pause & rollback and open sub-issue for targeted retraining (ENG-7323).
